correctness.rationale: Frozen RESULT.md proof reconstructs every possible MSD right context. A length-l suffix r either has valuation nu_b(r+d)<l independent of the prefix, or r=(-d) mod b^l yields l+nu_b(n+q_l); offsets q_j=ceil(d/b^j) stabilize at 1 after K steps. Suffixes of lengths j recover all coordinates Phi(n), so equality of Phi is exactly Myhill–Nerode equivalence. Differences q_i-q_j have b-adic valuation <K; H<=K separates their marked low-order residues. Missing trie branches give fixed signatures; active leaves give m arbitrary residues in one coordinate; constructive n=b^e-q_i realizes every leaf signature. Hence the finite union equals the unbounded minimal state set and the O((log(c+2))^2) bound follows. Independent 896 parameter cases checked direct finite signatures against formula; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.
